question: According to Census of India 2011, the growth rate of Hindu population in the decade 2001-2011 was ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**16.8%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **16.8% **is the population growth rate of the Hindu community according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The Census of India is **conducted every ten years** and is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in India.
 
• The population growth rate is a crucial metric that helps in understanding the demographic changes and planning for future resource allocation and policy-making.
 
• The** Hindu community is the largest religious group in India, **and understanding its growth rate is important for various socio-economic planning initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The** first Census in India was conducted in 1872**, and since then, it has been conducted every ten years.
 
• The Census provides critical data on various parameters including population size, distribution, density, literacy, occupation, and more.
 
• The data collected through the Census is used for planning and formulation of policies for the central and state governments.
 
• The** 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country.**
